> [!NOTE]
> Unsure about something? Open a **Draft PR** and ask — we'd rather help than reject.

## Title

Format: `[Sheet Name] New Sheet: Description` — e.g. `[Dresden Files RPG] New Sheet: Initial submission`

## Checklist (all required)

- [ ] Title follows the format above
- [ ] Changes are limited to a single sheet folder
- [ ] No changes to `translations/*.json` (the sheet's own `translation.json` is fine)
- [ ] No publisher IP (logos, art, rules text) without documented permission
- [ ] I have followed the [Character Sheet Standards](https://wiki.roll20.net/Building_Character_Sheets#Roll20_Character_Sheets_Repository)

## Game Details

- **Game name:** 
- **Publisher:** 
- **System / family:** (e.g. Dungeons & Dragons, FATE)
- **Where the rules can be found:** (purchase link or ISBN)

**Publication status** (check one):
- [ ] Traditionally published game
- [ ] Independently / self-published game
- [ ] Unofficial fan game, hack, or homebrew system — describe: 

**Official sheet?** (leave unchecked for community sheets)
- [ ] The publisher has authorized this as an official Roll20 sheet with their name attached
- [ ] The publisher has contacted [licensing@roll20.net](mailto:licensing@roll20.net) to confirm
